comments.body: The ones I found in Lake Baikal are Survival +1 instead of Procurement as Guilder said, with r15 Search got 2 pairs in 20 minutes while r10 got nothing.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: With R14 Search, I spent a few hours trying to dig these up in the Sea of Okhotsk at various different landmarks without any success. When I tried the Large Ice landmark in Lake Baikal, I got several in just under 10 minutes. It's probably a coincidence but I figured I would mention it just to be safe.
